description: We are Constelacao Jovem, a team of students from SENAI in Brazil! We love space, creativity and storytelling. We chose the challenge Abandoned but not Forgotten to tell fun stories about the equipment NASA left on the Moon and Mars, for kids to learn and dream about space. We are looking for team members who like writing, drawing, video and design!
summary: Our project is a digital comic book called "Oppy: Abandoned but Not Forgotten." It tells the true story of Opportunity, the NASA rover that lived on Mars for 15 years, much longer than expected. Through fun and simple drawings, we show Oppy with his friends, his discovery of blueberries that proved there was water on Mars, and his final goodbye during a big dust storm. Our comic helps children learn about space, science, and friendship in an easy and emotional way. It addresses the challenge by making space exploration accessible and unforgettable. Oppy is important because he showed us that even a robot can be a hero and inspire us to keep exploring.
details:
Oppy: Abandoned but Not Forgotten is a digital comic book (HQ) that tells the story of Opportunity, NASA's rover that was left on Mars.

The HQ shows Oppy as a character who can think and feel. He works hard, explores Mars, sends photos to Earth, and one day he stops receiving messages. Even alone, he keeps his memories, his mission and his hope.

Our goal is to make people feel empathy for the machines NASA leaves in space and to understand that they are not just trash. They have history, science and a legacy.

We used Canva to create the HQ, with drawings, dialogues and pages made by our team. The story is simple and emotional so that children, teenagers and adults can understand it.

Our project is creative because we mixed science, art and storytelling. We thought about teamwork, easy language, and how to make a space story that anyone can feel.

The impact is to teach about Mars exploration, to value NASA missions and to inspire young people to like science and space.
